page.notes: The left margin notes are small and partly broken by hyphenation ("Armamen-/tarij præ-/fectus.", "Camera / Hovet- / MANNO- / RUM."); they are reconstructed as one note each. The text has a few doubtful spots: "habet(nam" and "fuit )" carry printed parentheses; "fabrûm" and "senatûs" have a printed circumflex-like mark that may be an accent or a stain; the spaced small capitals "H o v e t" in "quodH o v e t-" are rendered as HOVET-. Some hyphenated line breaks may have been rejoined with a printed hyphen where the word continues on the next line.
